description.en: Runs one goal as model-planned parallel subtasks and merges the reports into one answer. Run state is written to disk, so a host restart keeps the work and resume continues only the unfinished subtasks; call and token caps are enforced and the run's cost is printed.
description.zh: 把一个目标交给 planner 拆成并行子任务并合成一份报告。运行状态落盘，宿主重启后可继续、只补没做完的部分；每个 run 有调用数与 token 硬上限，结束时打印成本。
